pages.text: The Roost is the backbone of any chicken farm.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Place chicken items inside and the Roost periodically produces their configured drops into its internal output slots. No food, no mob AI, no lag.$(br2)Output rate scales with the growth, gain and strength of the birds and with how many share the Roost.

pages.title: Boosting Output
pages.text: Two things speed a Roost up:$(br)$(li)A $(l)Nest$() or $(l)Mechanical Nest$() aura nearby$(li)$(l)Speed$() and $(l)Stack$() upgrades installed in the Roost$(br2)Both stack with each other.
